plugins.name: wcag-report
plugins.description: Crawl a website or run a repository locally, check every page against WCAG 2.2 and produce a client-ready PDF accessibility report that passes an independent red-team review.

plugins.name: wcag-build
plugins.description: Build UI that meets WCAG 2.2 from the first version: before Claude plans a component, block or restyle, it works out which criteria the change could break and builds the requirements in.
